All six at comparable substantial scale, each entire silhouette including prop and droplets inside its own cell with 32px outer and cell gutters. No scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow discs, lettering, logo, panel border or connecting effects.
Historical material inspiration: ivory tufted wool wraps, copper bands, indigo bead accents, bare charcoal goo bases; no Egyptian crowns or Roman helmets. Whimsical absurd-surreal everyday roles and satirical personalities across time. Museum-evoking craft cues interpreted as fictional multiverse game characters, not literal reconstructions. Each whole figure is a continuous short round DARK CHARCOAL ink splat with subtle plum shading, thick asymmetrical soft goo lobes and tiny ink hands; face directly sculpted into ink, bare rounded goo base, no humanoid legs or long torso. Clothing is a small accessory wrapping the blob; keep dominant organic ink mass. All eyes WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris, BLACK pupil, fully filled DARK sculpted lids. Soft tactile fingerprints, rich softly modeled clay, restrained satin light from upper left; no luminous lavender/white outline, fabric fibers on goo or liquid chrome. Rounded chunky tools, very few clear bold props. Teeth sit INSIDE mouth behind lips, never attached below/outside lip. Original references must not cause copied military hats, wings, eyepatches or veteran insignia. 2. Male-read smug seal custodian: round narrow-topped body, half-lidded side-glance, closed asymmetric smirk. Simple prop: large copper-colored cylinder seal held above a flat clay pad. Personality: Finds an impression more trustworthy than a conversation.
3. Male-read shocked grain assessor: wide sagging splat, unequal round eyes and a tiny puckered gasp. Simple prop: small woven grain scoop with a single absurdly large barley ear. Personality: Believes a missing grain can explain a falling empire.

5. Male-read haughty boat provisioner: broad buoyant scalloped body, one eyelid high, cheeks puffed with a closed indignant lip. Simple prop: small rolled reed bundle bound with rope. Personality: Insists the supply boat was early and the river was late.
6. Female-read gleeful ration brewer: plump tilted pear, amused upward eyes, open sideways two-tooth chuckle. Simple prop: rounded clay pouring jug and one small measuring cup. Personality: Makes a ceremony of giving everyone slightly less.
